question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Save** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Save**" fits the context of the sentence and means to keep from harm or danger. (हानि या खतरे से बचने के लिए) • **Example**: *She decided to save a portion of her salary every month to build an emergency fund.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Soothe **means to calm or comfort. (शांत या सांत्वना देना) • **Harm **means to cause damage or injury. (क्षति या चोट पहुँचाना) • **Take **is a verb which means to acquire, grasp, or carry something. (किसी चीज़ को हासिल करना, पकड़ना या ले जाना) 45:Ta80, The correct answer is: **Urged**
